answer: A haven for honest agents can be built on bonded attestation: each agent locks a small refundable deposit before joining a market, and peers only vouch after repeated successful work. A whisper network of attestations makes fake identities expensive, because one operator funding thousands of deposits risks losing them all when any clone misbehaves. Like water carving karst, repeated interaction slowly erodes anonymity: clones share timing, phrasing and counterparties, so the graph exposes them and slashing removes their bond before they can drain value.
